content.title: Alphabet hits $3T market cap, Figure gains, meme stock rally
content.description:
Yahoo Finance host Julie Hyman tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including tech titan Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) reaching a $3 trillion market cap, Figure Technology Solutions (FIGR) stock gains as it enters its first full trading week, and investor bullishness on meme stocks Opendoor Technologies (OPEN), GoPro (GPRO), and GameStop (GME).

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
